I’ll join you: 15 tons today, with all $15,000 paid directly to the clinic, provided Jack also agrees and Luke keeps his catch at zero. Our families depend on the clinic and the lake, so I’m committing to the recovery too—no more than six tons next month, then ten once the lake is back at 100.

Before we launch, let’s record everyone’s catch limits and arrange the direct payments together. Jack, will you complete the agreement?
